goal: Prepare a bounded ProjectPortfolio SDLC pilot for human review
scope: Capture requirements and acceptance, hand off implementation on one isolated branch, and prepare a local draft PR packet
Run existing local preflight, regression, security, content and full validation gates with source-bound evidence
Validate every ready PR revision and draft browser behavior while cancelling superseded CI runs
Verify confirmed Cloudflare Pages deployment identity and exact published version before release sign-off
exclusions: No push, PR creation, merge, deploy, rollback, account or credential change, or new recurring trigger during this preparation
No Codex hooks changes, new paid provider, production script whitelist expansion, or branch-protection edits
Keep dependency PR180 separate and preserve primary checkout and existing weekly production smoke

acceptance.description: Validated requirements produce a reviewable handoff and draft PR packet without external writes
Non-draft revision events rerun full validation and draft PRs run bounded browser regression
Generated artifacts, resume freshness, security coverage, hygiene and source policies pass locally
Full validation including dependency audit, vendor and browser/accessibility gates passes on the reviewed source
Confirmed provider identity, exact SHA and immutable preview and production bytes pass deployment verification
Independent review and owner acceptance approve the exact diff and resolve production injection and preview redirects
Owner explicitly approves release and records known-good SHA/deployment and rollback evidence
